Rule: Payment must follow a matching purchase order, goods receipt and invoice (three-way match) within tolerance.
An invoice must not be paid twice; same vendor, amount and reference within a window is flagged.
The person who creates a purchase order must not approve it.
A purchase order raised after the invoice date is an after-the-fact order and is flagged.
Several orders to one vendor just below the approval threshold within a window are flagged as split orders.
A change to vendor bank details shortly before a payment is flagged for review.
A manual payment-block release is flagged unless approved by a second person.
A price or quantity change after approval above a tolerance is flagged.
A deviation is closed only by a person with a recorded cause and decision.
Thresholds and windows are parameters held in the control library with an owner and version.
